reviewed_by: Codex review of goal dashboard publication and immutable tool evidence wiring
reason: Goal-mode chat exposed dashboard.publish through a ToolBroker that had no evidence recorder. The tool could commit its structured result and then fail after execution when the broker enforced immutable evidence. The selected regression executes the real dashboard broker with Core storage and ArtifactStore and verifies a successful receipt with three immutable artifacts. The existing goal-tool integration test verifies fresh goal turns still expose dashboard.publish when the required artifact store is configured.
exclusions: No frontend, native, or Playwright tests because the UI, desktop shell, browser behavior, and API contract are unchanged. Container runners, network tools, unrelated chat lifecycle behavior, and full suites are excluded. The focused Python tests use an in-process Core database and real filesystem-backed ArtifactStore without network access.
